help.model: Determines the AI engine powering this assistant. Stronger models understand nuance but are slower
help.tools: Permissions that enable the assistant to perform specific tasks

header.noSelectionHint: Select an agent to view details

empty.title: Start building your smart team
empty.desc: Choose from available AI agent templates to activate auto-reply, sales management, or customer service in your store.

settings.descriptionPlaceholder: Brief description of the assistant's role
settings.purposePlaceholder: Example: Helps me manage Facebook orders and reply to customers
settings.purposeHint: Describe in plain language what you want this assistant to do
settings.autonomyDesc: Determines how independently the assistant can act
settings.suggestDesc: Suggests actions and waits for your approval
settings.approvalDesc: Handles simple tasks, asks for approval on important ones
settings.autoDesc: Performs all tasks within its permissions
settings.personaHint: Additional persona instructions added above the base template, does not affect SOUL.md
settings.personaPlaceholder: Write the agent's persona, reply style, tone of voice, or any additional brand instructions...
settings.goalHint: What is the main outcome this assistant should achieve?
settings.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Help customers choose products and complete orders
settings.toneHint: Choose the tone that fits your store and customers
settings.tasksHint: List the tasks the agent can help with
settings.tasksPlaceholder: e.g. Answer questions, search products, create orders
settings.boundariesHint: Define what the agent must not do
settings.boundariesPlaceholder: e.g. Do not change prices, do not cancel orders without approval
settings.languageHint: Choose the default language for replies
settings.welcomeHint: Optional greeting shown to the customer at the start of a chat
settings.welcomePlaceholder: e.g. Hello! I am your personal assistant, how can I help?
settings.escalationHint: What should the assistant do when it does not know the answer?
settings.customPromptPlaceholder: e.g. Avoid English terms, address the customer by first name...
settings.customPromptHint: Free-form field for any additions beyond the templates
settings.personaOverrideHint: Additional guidelines the agent adheres to in its replies to reflect your store policies

quickTest.title: Quick Agent Test
quickTest.subtitle: Send a test message to preview how this agent replies to your customers.
quickTest.placeholder: Type a test message (e.g., Hi, what are the product prices and delivery options?)
quickTest.error: Failed to connect to agent at this moment

archive.title: Archive Agent
archive.confirm: Are you sure you want to archive {{name}}?

delete.confirmPrefix: Are you sure you want to delete agent

guardrails.saveSuccess: Workflow rule created and activated successfully 🛡️
guardrails.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to permanently delete this rule?
guardrails.title: Dynamic Behavior & Arbitration Rules
guardrails.desc: Configure agent behavior constraints and prevent policy violations (booking times, prices, reservations) by simply writing instructions.
guardrails.addTitle: Add new rule in plain language
guardrails.inputPlaceholder: Example: 'Do not give more than 10% discount on Friday' or 'Saturday is ladies only salon, do not book for men'
guardrails.emptyDesc: Write your first instruction in the field above to secure and adjust agent behavior.
guardrails.conflictDesc: We found semantic similarity with an existing rule. Please review the conflict below to avoid AI confusion:

permanentDelete.title: Delete Agent Permanently
permanentDelete.confirm: Are you sure you want to permanently delete this agent? This action cannot be undone.
